text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
'Tis because I practiced! Naturally, this 
was to be expected!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Time for the final pose! Ready? One, two, 
go!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Seiya!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, No Reason!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's not dancing, that's kabuki~! What a 
surprise~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
When I dance, my body just moves on its 
own... I need to dance more normally.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, just regular dancing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, just the final pose! —Ready, 
set!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Seiya!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, you're doing kabuki again! Dance with 
us instead!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is no use... I yearn so fiercely to 
perform kabuki that my body tingles with 
restlessness... refusing to obey me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmm, this is troubling...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing a familiar voice, I took a peek 
and saw No Reason struggling with her 
dance practice.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Whenever my spirits get fired up, 
my Kabuki side just comes out...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it is that... that I am 
constantly exposed to the fiery passion of 
Kabuki...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I want to let my feelings out... but 
Kabuki is a no-go... What am I supposed to 
do?
choice_data_list: Just be yourself when you dance!

Why not incorporate kabuki into it 
instead?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...! Oh, how blind I was! All I had to do 
was put my feelings into the dance as 
well!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Alright, without further ado!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH! An upset! It's an UPSEEEEEET!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
âCome now, Mirako, you too! Put your 
heart into the dance!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, y-yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO! No pool! Say no to the pool!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A passionate dance unfolded, powerfully 
expressing who they truly were.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I see! Don't hold back unnecessarily, and 
make sure to value expressing oneself!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Seiya! Soiya!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Look here, Mirako! Kabuki is supposed to 
be way more dignified, like this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fueh~, why do I have to do Kabuki too~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two practiced a new dance 
incorporating Kabuki elements.
